extensions.description: Manage versioned RLE resources from a host-agnostic rle.toml manifest. Commands are hidden by default; set AZD_AI_RLE_ENABLE=true to enable them. Set AZD_AI_RLE_HARNESS_INIT_ENABLE=true to preview harness scaffolds. (Preview)

examples.name: init
examples.description: Select a Gym: OpenEnv sample or, with the harness preview flag, scaffold a Harness: HostedAgent or Harness: BYOH RLE.

examples.name: publish
examples.description: Build, push, and publish the RLE release declared in rle.toml.

examples.name: run
examples.description: Build and run the local RLE environment container.

examples.name: invoke
examples.description: Execute one Loom-backed rollout of a published RLE environment (provisions and tears down the Loom session for you; --model falls back to rle.toml's defaults.model.name).

examples.name: list
examples.description: List RLE environments in a Foundry project.

examples.name: show
examples.description: Show the details and version history for an RLE environment.
